value.rationale: Symmetric double-well quartic at (-4,1) with a^2=2,b^2=6 is a natural integer reference point in the two-cut regime, and cubic trace is the natural odd observable maximally sensitive to filling imbalance; both motivated before computation. Full-limit non-existence with two explicit distinct finite even/odd variances (gap ~64.6) is a structural parity-oscillation fact, not a textbook exercise, parameter rename, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Values were unknown and not mechanically implied; future work on multi-cut fluctuations can retrieve the precise constants. Narrow exact invariant is eligible without a new general theorem.
